Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. This new feature lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so your favorite ways of looking at a project are always one click away instead of being rebuilt from scratch every time you log in.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, deadline, or teammate without worrying about running out of space. Once you've set up a view that works well, you can share it with your team so everyone sees the same layout and stays aligned on what matters most, whether that's a sprint board, a client-facing task list, or a personal to-do queue.

Saved Views is included in every paid plan at no extra cost, and it works across all your existing lists right away. No setup, no migration, no waiting.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
